<subject>Inquiry About Employment Opportunities</subject>
<body>
Hello Larry,

I was wondering if Lakeshore Municipal Utilities is currently hiring for Information Systems positions? My brother-in-law recently graduated with a degree in Management Information Systems and is seeking a job after the summer. He is completing his final classes this summer.

He mentioned an interest in working with ERP systems and PeopleSoft, though I'm not entirely sure what those entail.

Could you please assist me with any information?

Thank you,
Ken Van Pelt
</body>
